articles.summary: New Allegiant Training Program invests in flight attendant development through a first-of-its-kind collaboration with one of the world's leading hospitality schools. ( NASDAQ: ALGT ) is taking the next step in its customer experience journey through a new partnership with the University of Nevada, Las Vegas (UNLV) William F. Harrah College of Hospitality, bringing a customized customer experience training program to flight attendants across its network. The program leverages UNLV's expertise in service culture and training to strengthen Allegiant's customer experience as the airline grows. "Continuous learning is essential in a dynamic industry like aviation," said Tyler Hollingsworth, Allegiant's Chief Operating Officer. "This program encourages our teams to embrace new ideas and apply fresh insights that can make a meaningful impact for in-flight team members."
